history.summary: A new-launch (2027 TOP) freehold 1BR+study, 530 sqft at $1.33M / $2,509 psf in D15 — extreme PSF for a shoebox even with the advertised '$200k developer discount'. The lowest Elo (991) and worst record (111-202) in the batch reflect a badly overpriced, niche unit.
history.rating_rationale: $2,509 psf for a 530 sqft 1BR+study is paying CCR-prime money for an OCR/RCR-fringe shoebox 830m from Dakota MRT; the '$200k developer discount' is marketing framing off an inflated list, not value. Arena Elo of 991 with a 111-202 record is the clearest loser in the set, score_1000 of 509 is barely market-typical despite the value-tilt, and 1BR+study at a $1.33M quantum is a thin resale segment. New-launch bias with no resale floor and no URA data to anchor — high overpay risk.
